items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s what it’s like when Sam Woodyard went in there, and Louie Bellson.

ctx.x: You said he wanted Miles in the band too?

Oh yeah, one time. He wanted Charlie Parker. He was up on it. But I had played with Luis Russell’s band, and I knew that certain people in the band wouldn’t want to deal with my foolishness. What I mean by that is, when you’re with a big band, you got to hold that band together. That’s what it’s like when Sam Woodyard went in there, and Louie Bellson. They really did it. They did it. I probably would have wanted to stray different directions, maybe. I don’t know if it would have jelled. Maybe. I would have had to…
